questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

Options:
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the meeting time?

Options:
options: It was at nine o'clock that we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was at nine o'clock that we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was at nine o'clock that we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was at nine o'clock that we decided to postpone the meeting.
questions.answer: It was at nine o'clock that we decided to postpone the meeting.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.

Options:
options: If she were here, she would help us with the project.
If she were here, she would help us with the project.
If she were here, she would help us with the project.
If she were here, she would help us with the project.
questions.answer: If she were here, she would help us with the project.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly employs ellipsis to avoid repetition.

Options:
options: He doesn't like apples, whereas his sister does.
He doesn't like apples, whereas his sister does.
He doesn't like apples, whereas his sister does.
He doesn't like apples, whereas his sister does.
questions.answer: He doesn't like apples, whereas his sister does.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences uses formal register appropriately in a business context?

Options:
options: I would be obliged if you could send me the details by the end of the day.
I would be obliged if you could send me the details by the end of the day.
I would be obliged if you could send me the details by the end of the day.
I would be obliged if you could send me the details by the end of the day.
questions.answer: I would be obliged if you could send me the details by the end of the day.
